prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: a full-width celebration scene for Aventura Lectora on a monochrome e-ink game. Landscape 3:2 composition. Match a cute Japanese RPG storybook coloring-book style: bold smooth black outlines, clean simple shapes, white and only two flat gray tones, generous white space, no gradients, no hatching, no text, no numbers, no UI, no borders, no watermark. The scene must remain legible at 480x320. No people, no animals, no weapons, no enemies. Keep the bottom 40 percent as a clear light foreground with a simple curved stone path where the app will overlay its existing hero on the left and pet on the right. Place the celebration motif in the upper and middle background and framing details at the sides; never fill the foreground with objects. This is a cheerful achievement, reading gives the magic. Scene: A woodland clearing at a milestone in a reading journey. Two rounded ancient trees form a welcoming arch. At the center in the mid-background a large open book on a low stone pedestal releases a few broad ribbon-shaped pages and simple sparkles. Leaf garlands drape high between the trees. Tiny distant village visible through the arch. Friendly, warm, triumphant, crisp silhouettes. Keep center bottom foreground open and pale.
